title: Published sea turtle dive-depth examples
description: Depth information comes from separate, cited diving studies, not the OBIS-SEAMAP occurrence export. These metrics differ in population, behavior, and statistical meaning; they are not species-wide average swimming depths and are not synchronized with sighting dates or locations.

chart_axes.distance_note: No distance is supplied. Calculate distance only from consecutive valid locations belonging to one identified telemetry track.
chart_axes.depth_note: Display the cited metric as a labeled study example or band. Do not animate an individual turtle at an invented fixed depth or attach these values to sighting locations.

study_examples.sample_context: Six nesting females at Ascension Island; deeper resting dives were rare.

study_examples.metric: depth band occupied for approximately 80% of tracked time
study_examples.sample_context: 26 adult female tracks in the northern Gulf of Mexico; study-specific time use.

study_examples.metric: range of individual mean maximum dive depths
study_examples.sample_context: Northern Australia telemetry study; these are individual means of maximum depths, not a range of all dives.
Reported as 200 ± 20 m in the cited study; ±20 m is the study's reported uncertainty, not a population depth range.
